name: com.privyde/executive-transport
title: PRIVYDE Private Chauffeur
description: Private chauffeur from Madrid across Spain and Portugal: services, fleet, quotes, booking links.

tools.name: list_services
tools.description: List Privyde private chauffeur services (weddings, corporate events, airport transfers, chauffeur by the hour, etc.).

lang.description: Language for names and URLs. Defaults to "es".

tools.name: list_cities
tools.description: List the cities Privyde serves. Madrid is the base (local transfers, airport, chauffeur at disposal); the others are ends of long-distance trips in both directions, with no local service inside them.

lang.description: Language for names and URLs. Defaults to "es".

tools.name: list_fleet
tools.description: List Privyde vehicles with capacity (passengers, luggage) and category. The Mercedes-Benz V300 Atelier Collection is the main vehicle (own fleet, bookable on the website); the other categories are on request, subject to confirmation.

lang.description: Language for names and URLs. Defaults to "es".

tools.name: list_popular_routes
tools.description: List popular point-to-point routes with indicative starting price (EUR), distance and duration.

lang.description: Language for names and URLs. Defaults to "es".

tools.name: get_company_info
tools.description: Get Privyde company info: what it offers, coverage, fleet, contact channels (WhatsApp 24/7 and email), how booking and payment work, prices from, minimum notice and cancellation, all read live from the rate card.

lang.description: Language for names and URLs. Defaults to "es".

tools.name: get_quote
tools.description: Price a transfer, an hourly/daily disposal or a long-distance trip from the published rate card, read-only, exactly like POST /api/v1/quote: per real road kilometre, closed at booking. Never an estimate: when the trip cannot be measured or needs a human, the answer says so (quotable: false, requiresHumanValidation, reasonCode) instead of inventing a price. Returns the fare for the requested tier and, when quotable, the other tier's total too. Not saved (persisted: false, no quoteId): to actually request the service, call POST /api/v1/booking or build a link with get_booking_link. The pickup must respect the minimum notice (longer at night, and it depends on the vehicle category; https://privyde.com/developers#lead-time).

lang.description: Language for names and URLs. Defaults to "es".

serviceType.description: SRV_TRANSFER = point to point with one end in the Madrid region; SRV_DISPOSITION = chauffeur at disposal by the hour or by the day; SRV_LONG_DISTANCE = intercity, in either direction.

tier.description: Vehicle class to price. Only TIER_ATELIER (Mercedes-Benz V300 Atelier, up to 6 passengers) returns a price; TIER_STANDARD is subject to confirmation (quotable: false, no amount).

destination.description: Drop-off location. Required unless serviceType is SRV_DISPOSITION.

originLocality.description: Town of the pickup, when known (keeps a province from being mistaken for a city).

date.description: Pickup date, YYYY-MM-DD, Madrid calendar date.

time.description: Pickup time, 24h HH:MM, Madrid wall-clock time.

dispositionArea.description: Main area or destination of an "at disposal" service. Required for SRV_DISPOSITION once card-on-file is enabled (currently off); informational, never priced.

tools.name: contact_concierge
tools.description: Get Privyde contact channels (WhatsApp, email, contact page) to reach a human concierge.

lang.description: Language for names and URLs. Defaults to "es".

tools.name: get_booking_link
tools.description: Build a pre-filled booking link from known trip details for the user to review and submit. Returns a URL only: it does NOT submit a booking. The booking is a request confirmed by a human afterwards. The pickup must respect the minimum notice (Madrid time, longer at night, and it depends on the vehicle category; https://privyde.com/developers#lead-time), which the booking form checks.

lang.description: Language for names and URLs. Defaults to "es".
